prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: production RimWorld 3x2 shipboard safe battery sprite. Replace the tiny red button/blue light and their little surround entirely. NEW LAYOUT: upper half contains three chunky grey battery-cell modules side by side. Do not make it a tiny control, a narrow edge, or a thin stripe. It should look integrated into the equipment as a big flat indicator/contactor panel. The case perimeter remains medium/dark grey, compact chamfered corners with 4-5% transparent margin. Only a few broad mechanical divisions and restrained minimal detail. Keep all artwork inside the canvas. No text, digits, logos, arrows, symbols, ground, drop shadow, isometric sides, decorative lights or baked-in charge fill. Deliver only the neutral base sprite, not red/green variants or a mask. True alpha transparency.
